headline: Colombia Central Bank Purchases $2 Billion from Government for Reserves
summary: The Banco de la República purchased $2 billion from the Colombian government to bolster the nation's international reserves. The transaction was executed at the prevailing market exchange rate.
why: Central bank reserve accumulation is a standard practice to provide a buffer against external economic shocks and maintain currency stability.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Increased foreign reserves improve a country's external financial position.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
